name: Gorillack!
summary:
Welcome to Gorillack—a wild and energetic VR experience where movement is all in your hands—literally. Spawn into a lively forest full of personality, complete with cozy tents and a slick in-game computer where you can customize your display name and choose your favorite color.

From there, explore a wide variety of exciting maps, each offering new places to climb, jump, and swing around like a true primate. Show off your style with tons of unlockable cosmetics, and get ready for action in the intense Infec
